title: Harness: stochastic seeding and versioned run-metadata for reproducible profile generation
creator: Priya Singh
description: Improve the benchmark harness so generated performance profiles are reproducible and auditable across environments. This ticket adds a deterministic/stochastic seeding strategy, a compact versioned run_metadata schema to accompany every profile artifact, and small adapters for eval runners to emit unified metadata. Goals: enable playback of sample runs in CI, allow rollback/diff of profiles with clear provenance (model pin, harness version, dataset fingerprint), and minimize noise from non-deterministic hardware or kernel choices.
acceptance_criteria: Every profile publish includes a run_manifest.json that contains: hashed_run_id, harness_version, model_version_or_sha, seed_strategy, seed_values (if applicable), dataset_fingerprint, prompt_set_fingerprint, runner_name, runtime_topology_tag, and environment_notes

Given the same model binary (pinned SHA), harness_version, and run_manifest seeds, 95%+ of sampled example outputs (deterministic checksums) match on two different CI hosts running identical container images
Eval runners updated to emit prompt-level fingerprints and sampling parameters (temperature, top_p, sampling_method) into run_manifest
CI playback job that re-runs 100 selected samples and fails the pipeline if checksums deviate beyond threshold
Profile publishing tool uploads run_manifest alongside artifacts and indexes them so console can show provenance and allow model/version rollbacks
progress_updates: 2025-02-18: Kickoff meeting with benchmarking, runtime, and infra. Agreed scope: seeding API in harness core + run_manifest schema + minimal runner adapters for conversational and text-gen runners. Not covering embedding determinism for now.

2025-02-21: Spike: implemented prototype seed manager in harness core that supports 'deterministic' (single global seed), 'per-example' (seed per input derived from hashed prompt), and 'stochastic' (PRNG with stored seed_values). Found divergence on A100 vs T4 due to kernel nondeterminism — flagged to runtime team.

2025-02-24: Design review with Runtime (Daniel Park) — decision to record runtime_topology_tag and kernel_metadata in run_manifest. Runtime to add a lightweight kernel-variant tag in next patch to help triage nondeterminism.
2025-02-27: Added prompt_set fingerprinting using sha256 of canonicalized prompt list. Created adapter shim for existing text-gen runner. Tests added for fingerprint generation.

2025-03-03: PR #4120 opened for harness core seed manager and run_manifest writer. Initial CI playback job implemented but flaky on GPU multithreaded kernels; added retries and tolerance thresholds to avoid noisy failures.
2025-03-05: PM review (Maya Chen) requested explicit model pin format in run_manifest (both human label and pinned SHA). Incorporating change; target to merge before due date.
decisions: Adopt a small JSON run_manifest (v1) stored alongside artifacts instead of Protobuf to accelerate iteration and ease debugging.
Seed strategy: default to 'per-example' for deterministic profile runs; allow 'stochastic' for variance studies with recorded seed_values array
Record both model_tag (e.g., 'llama-3-13b') and model_pinned_sha (git or model-artifact SHA) to separate human-friendly and authoritative pins

Do not attempt to eliminate hardware nondeterminism in this ticket — instead capture kernel/runtime metadata and add a CI playback tolerance threshold; runtime team to pursue kernel determinism separately
Backward compatibility: manifest v1 will include an optional 'legacy_checksums' map to ease migration of older profiles
notes: Trade-offs considered: using Protobuf would save bytes and be schema-typed, but JSON reduces friction for ad-hoc inspection when diagnosing profile regressions.
Longer-term: consider canonical binary run_record for storage efficiency and signed manifests for tamper-proofing when we add enterprise private deployments.
Follow-up: add runner adapter for reranker/eval pipeline (separate ticket) and extend playback suite to cover embeddings and streaming outputs.
